P7528.corridor_notes: GEM's own StartLocation='Yanqiao' / EndLocation='Wucheng' match two real, correctly-paired towns within Wuwei City (Yanqiao Town in the northeast of Wuwei City, Wucheng Town as the county seat further southwest) -- geographically this reads as a short lateral/spur pipeline bringing gas from a junction point on the larger P7527 trunk (which the corridor evidence suggests also passes through Yanqiao, see P7527's corridor_notes) into Wuwei City's own urban core at Wucheng. A now-dead source (gas.in-en.com, page returned HTTP 404 on this pass, previously titled '天然气巢湖—无为干线管道项目公示') and an unreachable one (search-snippet-only, no working URL retained) both separately described a ~22km, DN500 'Chaohu-Wuwei trunk' project -- consistent in scale with this row's LengthMergedKm=23.16km and with a DN500 lateral (smaller-diameter than P7527's DN700 trunk), but neither could be verified/cited in this pass.
P7528.researcher_notes: This PID's own ResearcherNotes state 'P4588 consists of two parts: P7527 and P7528' -- i.e. GEM already tracks P7528 as one component of a parent project P4588 alongside P7527. Given the corridor evidence assembled while researching P7527 (Yanqiao sits on/near the P7527 trunk route, in Wuwei City), the most coherent read is: P7527 = the Lujiang-Chaohu trunk (Lubei -> ... -> Yanqiao -> ... -> Huashan), and P7528 = a shorter DN500 lateral branching off at/near Yanqiao to serve Wucheng (Wuwei's urban core) -- i.e. P4588 as a whole is the combined trunk+lateral project. This is offered as context, not as an independently-sourced claim for P7528 itself.
